semiconductor_relevance: High — centrotherm specializes in production equipment for various semiconductor technologies, including power semiconductors and memory devices.
summary: centrotherm is a leading developer and manufacturer of production equipment tailored for semiconductor technologies, including logic, memory, and power devices. Their product portfolio features advanced furnaces and systems designed for high-temperature processes, catering to both R&D and mass production needs.
capabilities: Horizontal and vertical batch furnaces for atmospheric and vacuum processes
High-temperature furnaces for annealing and oxidation up to 2000°C
Single wafer systems for RTP and low-temperature microwave oxidation
Vacuum soldering systems and conveyor furnaces for thermally activated processes
